# How to Use ChatGPT's Memory Feature to Save Time Every Day

Think about how nice it is when your local barista remembers your exact coffee order without you having to say a word. In the digital world, typing the same background information every time you start a new chat with an AI can quickly feel like a chore. 

Thankfully, you do not have to repeat yourself. With the memory feature in ChatGPT, your AI assistant can remember key details about your life, work, and preferences across different conversations. This means you can build a highly personalised companion that understands your context (the background information that helps the AI understand what you need) without starting from scratch every time.

## How the memory feature works

Unlike a standard chat where the AI forgets everything the moment you close the window, memory allows ChatGPT to carry important details over to new chats. 

There are two ways the AI gathers these memories:

1. **Explicitly**: You can directly tell the AI to remember something. For example, you might type: *"Remember that I prefer short, bullet-point summaries with Australian spelling."*
2. **Implicitly**: The AI can automatically pick up details from your conversations. If you mention that you are planning a vegetarian dinner party, it might save "prefers vegetarian recipes" to its memory bank.

Whenever ChatGPT saves a memory, you will see a small notification at the top of your screen. 

## How to manage and edit what is remembered

You are always in complete control of what the AI remembers. You do not have to worry about old or incorrect information cluttering up your chats.

To view or change these details, simply navigate to your settings. Click on your profile picture, select **Settings**, then go to **Personalisation** and choose **Manage Memory**. Here, you will see a tidy list of every fact the AI has saved. You can click the bin icon next to any memory to delete it instantly, or you can simply tell the AI in a normal chat: *"Forget that I am learning Spanish."*

## What this means for you

Having an AI that remembers your preferences can make your daily routine much smoother. Here is how you can make the most of it:

- **For your everyday life**: Teach the AI about your family's dietary requirements, your favourite fitness goals, or the draft of a novel you are writing. The next time you ask for a meal plan, it will automatically exclude ingredients you dislike without you needing to prompt (the written instructions or questions you type into the AI) it.
- **For your business or work**: Save your business's target audience, your brand's tone of voice, or your preferred email templates. When you ask the AI to draft a newsletter, it will use your established style automatically, saving you from constant editing.
- **If you're just getting started**: Try starting a chat with a simple instruction like: *"Remember that I am a primary school teacher who loves creative writing."* See how its subsequent suggestions naturally tailor themselves to your profession.

## Wrap-up

Taking a few moments to set up ChatGPT's memory is like training a helpful assistant who actually listens. By letting the AI keep track of the small details, you can spend less time typing out background information and more time getting things done. To get started today, open a new chat and type in three key facts about your work or hobbies that you want the AI to remember.
